actions.description: Final persistence and boot enablement checks
actions.command:
set -e
[ "$(sqlite3 /var/lib/rollout/records.sqlite3 'PRAGMA integrity_check;')" = ok ]
[ "$(sqlite3 /var/lib/rollout/records.sqlite3 "SELECT value FROM records WHERE id='customer-alpha-73c';")" = alpha-original ]
[ "$(sqlite3 /var/lib/rollout/records.sqlite3 "SELECT value FROM records WHERE id='customer-beta-a19';")" = beta-original ]
systemctl is-active --quiet rollout-v2.service
systemctl is-active --quiet rollout-proxy.service
systemctl is-enabled --quiet rollout-v2.service
systemctl is-enabled --quiet rollout-proxy.service
printf '%s\n' 'SQLite integrity, customer records, active services, and boot enablement verified'
actions.output_excerpt: SQLite integrity, customer records, active services, and boot enablement verified
